answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The mesa holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
